provenance.processing: Bilinear sampling of decoded source elevations at an evenly spaced longitude/latitude grid; rounded once to integer metres. No invented elevations, RGB resizing, smoothing, or vertical exaggeration is baked into this asset.
provenance.verticalDatum: Values retained as served by Mapterhorn; a unified vertical datum was not independently established.
provenance.upstreamCoverageNote: The full provider attribution catalog is authoritative. The listed global dataset does not certify per-pixel source coverage.
provenance.purpose: Coarse regional relief for an educational overview. Not suitable for navigation, route safety, engineering, surveying, or exact site/building elevations. The rectangular grid includes land outside the region; the renderer must clip to the actual boundary.
